evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: MISSING — Rep jumps straight into address confirmation: 'Alright. Perfect. Okay, and so we'll start by confirming some addresses we are moving you from 6201 Chapel Hill Boulevard...' No time-box, no 'you can walk away with a quote you can depend on,' no wait for a yes.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: MISSING — Rep never asks 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' Moves directly to logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: PARTIAL — Rep gives a time estimate ('two and a half to three and a half hour mark') but no price range anchor and minimal personalization: 'We don't have anything too crazy.'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: MISSING — No trip fee, overnight fee, packing materials disclosed. No 'not a guess' or 2.5-hour-minimum commitment framing.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: MISSING — Never asked 'Does that feel fair?' or equivalent.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: THROWAWAY — 'And then did you have any other questions that I can help answer today?' is a generic throwaway, not 'What's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: NEVER — Rep never asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' Instead, rep moves directly to sending the email: 'Well, the reason I just sent that email over to your inbox...'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: PARTIAL — Date (the tenth) and arrival window (2:00–2:30) confirmed. Phone number not confirmed, crew size not stated, notes for crew about concerns mentioned but loosely ('just reply with that information in the email').

top_strength: Chauntelle gathered thorough logistics details (addresses, floor layout, truck access, stairwell configuration, large items, TVs, box count) and documented special considerations clearly for the moving crew.
coaching_note: This call skipped the entire sales structure — no quid pro quo framing, no concerns discovery, no pricing transparency, no promises, and crucially no explicit ask for the business; rep sent a quote via email instead of closing on the call itself.
